description: This file implements the Login page component for a gym management system's frontend. It handles user authentication via email/password and Google Sign-In using Google Identity Services, manages tokens, and navigates upon successful login.

methods.name: Login()
methods.description: React functional component implementing the login page with authentication logic and Google Sign-In integration.

methods.name: handleGoogleCredential
methods.description: Callback invoked upon receiving Google credential; exchanges credential for tokens and navigates.

methods.name: setupGis
methods.description: Initializes Google Identity Services script, renders sign-in button, and prompts One Tap.

methods.name: handleSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission for email/password login, calling the login method and navigating on success.
